verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe a built-in AI agent that helps you "design, and animate" and can "generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation." They also document MCP tools that let AI create Layouts and Shapes, plus a CLI that lets an agent generate interactive UI, so prompt-driven drafting and editing of designs inside the tool is documented first-party. Missing for 10: any detail or examples of producing full mockups or visual first drafts from a prompt, depth on prompt-based editing of existing designs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent's design output works well.
